questions.q: What is a habitat?
options: A group of organisms of the same species
The food eaten by an organism
The natural surroundings or home of an organism

questions.q: A population is a group of organisms
options: of the same species that live in the same habitat
of different species that live together

questions.q: A community is
options: a few populations of different organisms living together in one habitat
a single species in many habitats

questions.q: An ecosystem consists of
options: a few communities together with the non-living components such as water, air and soil

questions.q: Mutualism is an interaction that
options: benefits one organism without affecting the other
benefits one organism and harms the other

questions.q: Commensalism is an interaction that
options: benefits one and harms the other
benefits one organism without harming or benefitting the other

questions.q: Parasitism is an interaction that
options: benefits one organism and harms the other

questions.q: Which is an example of parasitism?
options: A tapeworm living in the human intestine

questions.q: Which is an example of mutualism?
options: Algae and fungi living together as lichens
Bird's nest fern on a tree

questions.q: What is biological control?
options: Using natural predators, parasites or pathogens to reduce the number of pests
Using chemical pesticides to kill pests
